Messages.Author: SwiftOne
Messages.Body:
I'm poking about the cardlists on the white wolf site, and I'm having
some troubles figuring out what different parts mean.

I've figured out the Disciplines, card types, cost, expansion, etc. My
difficulty is with some of the card texts.

Is text in <> errata? For example:
-----------------
Aggressive Tactics (Sabbat)
2 pool -- Sabbat -- Master
Master. Put this card in play and choose a Methuselah. The chosen
<Methuselah's hand size is reduced by one>. This card may be burned
by any vampire as <a> (D) action.
----------------
It's unclear. The <a> (D) action looks like it, but the earlier section
looks more like a parenthetical.
Another example:
----------------------
Anarch Revolt (Jyhad, V:TES)
Master
Master. Put this card in play. Each Methuselah burns 1 pool during
his or her untap phase. Any vampire can burn this card with a
successful <referendum>; calling this <referendum> is a +1 stealth
<political> action.
---------------------
Archon (Jyhad, V:TES)
Political Action
Political Card-Worth 1 Vote. Called by any Prince or Justicar at
+1 stealth. Choose a vampire. Successful <referendum> makes the vampire
an Archon. <An> Archon may enter combat with another vampire <controlled
by another Methuselah> as a +1 stealth <(D)> action. <Any vampire>
attempting to block <an> Archon burns 1 blood. <A Blood Hunt cannot be
called on an Archon>. [Any vampire can remove these abilities with a
successful referendum; calling that referendum is a +1 stealth political
action].
-------------------------
What do the [] mean? the <>?

Thanks

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
SwiftOne wrote:
>
> I'm poking about the cardlists on the white wolf site, and I'm having
> some troubles figuring out what different parts mean.
>
> I've figured out the Disciplines, card types, cost, expansion, etc. My
> difficulty is with some of the card texts.
>
> Is text in <> errata? For example:

> [snip]

> What do the [] mean? the <>?

The <> are for clarifications, including updates for new terminology. Thes
do not represent functional changes to card text.

The [] are for rulings. (resolutions of ambiguity in card text)

The {} are for errata. (functional changes to card text)
